Survivor sider2001four is Sider's 2001 book Four-Dimensionalism (OUP, ISBN 9780191529580). Member sider1997fourdimensionalis is a distinct 1997 journal article 'Four-Dimensionalism' in The Philosophical Review 106(2) (DOI 10.2307/2998357). Different works sharing only a title; the 1997 article and the 2001 monograph should not be merged.
